_what: Species that cannot be deposited in Pokemon HOME's GTS at all, so recommending one as a chip is recommending something impossible.
_how_we_know: The player, from the game. NONE of this repo's five sources covers HOME's own rules - they are about Champions - so there is nothing to scrape and nothing to check it against. Each entry says who confirmed it and when.
_open_question: Melmetal is a Mythical, and Mythicals are widely said to be undepositable in HOME's GTS. That general rule is NOT confirmed here and is not written into this file as if it were: Melmetal is the only Mythical in his HOME box, so there is nothing else to apply it to yet. If a second one arrives and is also refused, the rule earns its place.

Melmetal.note: "melmetal esta bloqueado del gts". He was unsure why - "debe ser porque es un pokemon que no esta presente en muchos juegos o no se".
